Name: Nyapu Style Sevinae for Alchemistry
Author: amillionand1fandoms
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Replace Sevinae's portrait with a portrait in the style of Nyapu. Meant to be used alongside Alchemistry, obviously, as otherwise you won't have Sevinae.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
Extract it from the .zip and put it in your mods folder.
If you have other mods that replace XXXX's portrait (For example, Slightly Cuter Characters) you should turn off XXXX in those mods.
